summary: Netlify production retry stays blocked until production baseline execution completes, migrate status is clean, and hosted proof + email diagnostics pass.

stages.label: Confirm production baseline execution completed.
stages.detail: Operator attests `npx prisma migrate deploy` (or DBA-equivalent) finished successfully against the confirmed production URL.

stages.label: Confirm `npx prisma migrate status` no longer reports all 71 migrations pending.
stages.detail: Against production DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL: applied count aligns with repo (71 migrations).

stages.label: Confirm Netlify env vars: DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, EMAIL_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN.
stages.detail: Names only in tickets; values verified in Netlify UI by authorized operator.

stages.label: Trigger Netlify deploy.
stages.detail: Only after Steve approves retry; `scripts/netlify-build.sh` runs `prisma generate` then `prisma migrate deploy`.

stages.label: Confirm build reaches and passes: prisma generate, prisma migrate deploy, Next build.
stages.detail: Build logs show each step green; investigate failures before re-triggering.

stages.label: Test hosted DB proof route without token.
stages.detail: Expect 401, 503, or JSON handler response — not 404 HTML (wrong deploy or missing route).

stages.label: Test hosted DB proof route with token.
stages.detail: Bearer token from secure channel only; never paste token into docs or chat.

stages.label: Test email diagnostics.
stages.detail: Run documented email diagnostics against hosted env (no PII export).

stages.label: Test SendGrid auth.
stages.detail: Verify API key scope / auth without enabling broadcast.

stages.label: Test SendGrid sandbox only.
stages.detail: Sandbox mode only — no production recipient blast.

stages.label: Keep live send blocked.
stages.detail: No live-send approval; no broadcast toggles until separate governance slice.
